en.title: Q1: frozen 03/05 confirmation
en.purpose: Check whether the development observations persist on MOT20-03 and MOT20-05 under frozen H-A/H-B criteria.
en.mechanism: The Q2 protocol links Q1 to a confirmation-freeze draft; RESULTS records the later one-time seven-system comparison, with decisions made separately for each sequence.
en.status: Approved historical finding: the recorded independent recomputation agrees on 14 system-by-sequence units, and H-A/H-B pass on both sequences.
en.limitation: Evidence is conditional on the sealed detection cache. P1/P2 baseline exposure and GPU execution conditions remain disclosed. Pooled values describe the combined sample.
en.question: Check whether the development observations persist on MOT20-03 and MOT20-05 under frozen H-A/H-B criteria.

zh.title: Q1：03/05冻结确认
zh.purpose: 在MOT20-03与MOT20-05上，用冻结的H-A/H-B判据检查开发观察是否延续。
zh.mechanism: Q2协议把Q1关联到确认冻结草案；RESULTS记录后续七系统一次性比较，并逐序列判定。
zh.status: 已有正式历史结论：独立复算的14个系统×序列单位一致，H-A/H-B在两段分别成立。
zh.limitation: 结论以封存检测缓存为条件，同时保留P1/P2基线曝光与GPU执行条件披露。合并值用于描述该合并样本。
zh.question: 在MOT20-03与MOT20-05上，用冻结的H-A/H-B判据检查开发观察是否延续。

en.title: Q2: shared recovery failures and blind visual review
en.purpose: Ask whether low-visibility events missed by all five systems show stronger evidence of limited visual observability than events recovered by at least three systems.
en.mechanism: Use the fixed 180 low-visibility 01/02 events and their existing global matches; compare shared misses with controls. Two independent reviewers answer visibility before, visibility after and actual crossing. Uncertainty ranges and practical criteria are fixed in the protocol.
en.status: PENDING_SECOND_HUMAN / NO_GROUP_UNBLINDING in the packaged record: the first reviewer is locked and the second review remains pending.
en.limitation: The inference is a conditional association in the sampled development events. Missing input/output lineage retains U_UNRESOLVED; visual judgments require the independent human review.
en.question: Ask whether low-visibility events missed by all five systems show stronger evidence of limited visual observability than events recovered by at least three systems.

zh.title: Q2：跨系统共同未找回与盲视觉核验
zh.purpose: 检查五系统共同未找回的低可见度事件，相比至少三系统找回的事件，是否有更强的视觉可观察性不足证据。
zh.mechanism: 固定使用01/02的180个低档事件及既有全局匹配，比较共同未找回组与对照组。两位真人独立回答越线前可见、越线后可见、是否实际穿越，并按预先固定的不确定范围和实用判据解释。
zh.status: 仓库历史记录为PENDING_SECOND_HUMAN / NO_GROUP_UNBLINDING：第一位已锁定，第二位待完成。
zh.limitation: 推断限于所抽开发事件中的条件关联。输入输出谱系缺失保留U_UNRESOLVED；视觉判断依赖独立真人核验。
zh.question: 检查五系统共同未找回的低可见度事件，相比至少三系统找回的事件，是否有更强的视觉可观察性不足证据。

en.title: Q3: reliability of derived reference labels
en.purpose: Check visual support for rule-derived crossings, including crossing, direction, identity, timing and supporting frames.
en.mechanism: Two reviewers independently inspect confirmed events, unconfirmed transitions and no-event search windows under versioned sampling, viewing and uncertainty rules.
en.status: Human QC completion remains a separate gate. Current guide context: Q3_v2 contains 93 formal items and #111 is separate. The packaged chain v1 → v2_78d → #86 → #87 documents historical plans and a 77-item batch.
en.limitation: The historical 77 items contain 72 confirmed samples, 4 unconfirmed items and 1 search window. Use the current package's own manifest for its 93-item accounting; material readiness and completed human review have separate status.
en.question: Check visual support for rule-derived crossings, including crossing, direction, identity, timing and supporting frames.

zh.title: Q3：派生参考标签可靠性核验
zh.purpose: 检查规则派生越线的视觉支持，涵盖穿越、方向、身份、时间与支持帧。
zh.mechanism: 两位真人按版本化抽样、观看和不确定规则，独立检查确认事件、未确认转换及无事件搜索窗。
zh.status: 人工QC完成有独立关口。导览当前状态：Q3_v2正式条目为93条，#111另包保存。仓库v1→v2_78d→#86→#87记录历史方案与77条批次。
zh.limitation: 旧77条由72条确认、4条未确认和1条搜索窗组成；当前93条应按当前包自身清单统计。材料就绪与真人完成分别记账。
zh.question: 检查规则派生越线的视觉支持，涵盖穿越、方向、身份、时间与支持帧。

en.title: Historical H1: residual anonymous-to-identity capacity gap
en.purpose: Ask whether a substantial anonymous-versus-identity gap survives an interpretation favorable to the frozen v11 system.
en.mechanism: Anonymous matching checks event time and location while leaving person identity out of the match. On each original core unit, compare clean anonymous capacity K_A_clean with optimistic identity capacity K_star. K_star uses raw final events with a ±1-second halo and relaxes unknown, ignored, neutral and halo identities. D_star = sum(max(0,K_A_clean−K_star)) / sum(K_A_raw). Each of 01 and 02 must have D_star ≥ 0.10, clean capacity ≥30 and at least 10 distinct GT identities in fixed anonymous matches.
en.status: STOP_CURRENT_CLAIM. The recorded v11 residuals are 1/59 for 01 and 11/517 for 02, both below 0.10. This belongs to the historical T3 H1/H2 namespace.
en.limitation: D_star is conditional on retained known identities and measures a capacity gap. The original core population has 671 confirmed events; later E1-v2 tables use 724 whole-sequence events. Confirmation H-A/H-B form a separate namespace.
en.question: Ask whether a substantial anonymous-versus-identity gap survives an interpretation favorable to the frozen v11 system.

zh.title: 历史H1：匿名—身份残余容量缺口
zh.purpose: 检查在尽量有利于冻结v11的宽松解释下，匿名匹配与身份匹配之间是否仍有实质缺口。
zh.mechanism: 匿名匹配只核对事件的时间和位置，人物身份另作检查。每个原核心单元比较清洗后匿名容量K_A_clean与乐观身份容量K_star。K_star使用核心窗前后各1秒的原始最终事件，并放宽unknown、ignore、neutral及halo身份。D_star=Σmax(0,K_A_clean−K_star)/ΣK_A_raw。01、02分别要求D_star≥0.10、清洗匿名容量≥30且固定匿名匹配涉及至少10个不同GT人物。
zh.status: STOP_CURRENT_CLAIM。历史v11残余为01的1/59、02的11/517，均低于0.10；此处属于T3历史H1/H2命名空间。
zh.limitation: D_star以保留known身份正确为条件，表达容量缺口。原核心母体为671条确认事件，后续E1-v2采用全序列724条。确认H-A/H-B另有独立命名空间。
zh.question: 检查在尽量有利于冻结v11的宽松解释下，匿名匹配与身份匹配之间是否仍有实质缺口。

en.title: Historical H2: near-correct totals masking identity loss
en.purpose: Ask whether apparently accurate event totals coexist with substantial identity-level recovery failure.
en.mechanism: Eligible units have N_G≥10; each sequence needs at least 2 eligible units. A masking unit has both raw and eligibility-filtered count errors ≤10%, while (N_G−K_star)/N_G≥20%. Each sequence needs at least 2 masking units covering ≥20% of eligible units, plus at least 3 distinct GT people across audited supporting components.
en.status: STOP_CURRENT_CLAIM. The recorded masking counts are 0/3 eligible units for 01 and 1/26 for 02. The historical T3 decision required H1 and H2 together on both sequences.
en.limitation: The thresholds govern a development investment decision. Competing event matches can identify a component's capacity deficit while leaving individual missed identities unresolved. Confirmation H-A/H-B use separate definitions.
en.question: Ask whether apparently accurate event totals coexist with substantial identity-level recovery failure.

zh.title: 历史H2：总量接近正确时的逐人损失
zh.purpose: 检查总事件数看似准确时，是否仍有实质规模的身份找回失败。
zh.mechanism: 合格单元要求N_G≥10，每段至少2个。masking单元要求原始计数与资格处理后计数误差均≤10%，且(N_G−K_star)/N_G≥20%。每段至少2个masking单元，占合格单元≥20%，核验支撑分量合计涉及至少3个不同GT人物。
zh.status: STOP_CURRENT_CLAIM。历史masking计数为01的0/3、02的1/26；T3原强主张要求H1与H2在两段同时成立。
zh.limitation: 这些阈值用于开发投入决策。竞争匹配可定位分量的容量缺口，而具体漏掉谁仍可能未决。确认H-A/H-B采用另一套定义。
zh.question: 检查总事件数看似准确时，是否仍有实质规模的身份找回失败。

en.title: Confirmation H-A: low/high visibility contrast
en.purpose: Check whether each of the three comparison panels has limited low-visibility recovery and strong recovery in the high-visibility bin on each confirmation sequence.
en.mechanism: For byte, oc and bot separately on both 03 and 05, require 10×low≤7×N_low and 10×high≥9×N_high, equivalent to low IVR≤70% and high IVR≥90%.
en.status: Approved historical confirmation finding: all six panel-by-sequence checks pass.
en.limitation: This criterion applies to the frozen three-panel comparison on the sealed cache. Historical H1/H2 belong to T3 and retain their STOP_CURRENT_CLAIM decision.
en.question: Check whether each of the three comparison panels has limited low-visibility recovery and strong recovery in the high-visibility bin on each confirmation sequence.

zh.title: 确认H-A：低高可见度对照
zh.purpose: 检查每个确认序列中，三个比较面板是否同时表现为低档找回有限、高档找回较高。
zh.mechanism: 03、05中byte、oc、bot分别满足10×low≤7×N_low且10×high≥9×N_high，即低档IVR≤70%、高档IVR≥90%。
zh.status: 已有正式历史确认结论：六个面板×序列检查全部成立。
zh.limitation: 判据覆盖封存缓存上的冻结三面板。历史H1/H2属于T3，继续保留STOP_CURRENT_CLAIM。
zh.question: 检查每个确认序列中，三个比较面板是否同时表现为低档找回有限、高档找回较高。

en.title: Confirmation H-B: YOLOX+v11 low-visibility comparison
en.purpose: Check whether YOLOX+v11 recovers more low-visibility identity events than every comparison panel on each confirmation sequence.
en.mechanism: Require the YOLOX+v11 low-bin count to exceed the maximum among byte, oc and bot, separately on 03 and 05.
en.status: Approved historical confirmation finding: 67>57 on 03 and 117>84 on 05.
en.limitation: The pooled 184/427 versus ByteTrack 140/427 difference is descriptive. Shared detections coexist with differences in admission, filtering, GMC and post-processing, so module-level attribution needs its own intervention evidence.
en.question: Check whether YOLOX+v11 recovers more low-visibility identity events than every comparison panel on each confirmation sequence.

zh.title: 确认H-B：YOLOX+v11低档比较
zh.purpose: 检查YOLOX+v11在每个确认序列的低档身份事件找回数是否超过所有比较面板。
zh.mechanism: 03、05分别要求YOLOX+v11低档正确数严格大于byte、oc、bot中的最大值。
zh.status: 已有正式历史确认结论：03为67>57，05为117>84。
zh.limitation: 合并184/427对ByteTrack的140/427用于描述。共享检测之外仍有准入、过滤、GMC与后处理差异，模块归因需要单独的干预证据。
zh.question: 检查YOLOX+v11在每个确认序列的低档身份事件找回数是否超过所有比较面板。

en.title: E1: event-level evidence attribution
en.purpose: Locate where saved evidence for one reference person's event stops supporting recovery.
en.mechanism: Follow admitted detection inputs, emitted tracker rows, same-person support on both sides, saved fragments and decoder stages. The mutually exclusive main outcomes are ① no compatible admitted detection, ② detected but not emitted, ③ missing track-side connection, ④ decoding/event localization, and ⑤ recovered. Explicit U categories preserve identity, matching, geometry, lineage and other unresolved cases.
en.status: Approved historical recomputation: 3,620 rows for P1/P2/v11/O1/O2 ×724 agree in main classes, subclasses and U subreasons. Independent visual review has a separate completion record.
en.limitation: Attribution is conditional on stored evidence, frozen thresholds and identity rules. Class ① concerns admitted-box compatibility. Human review assesses visual observability; causal explanations require additional evidence. U remains in the full denominator.
en.question: Locate where saved evidence for one reference person's event stops supporting recovery.

zh.title: E1：逐事件证据归因
zh.purpose: 沿同一个参考人物的事件，定位已保存证据在哪一阶段停止支持找回。
zh.mechanism: 串联实际入跟踪检测框、实际输出轨迹行、两侧同人支持、保存片段与解码阶段。互斥主类为①无兼容入池检测、②已检测但未输出、③缺少轨迹跨侧连接、④解码或事件定位、⑤找回；U类保留身份、匹配、几何、谱系等未决情况。
zh.status: 已有正式历史复算：P1/P2/v11/O1/O2×724共3620行的主类、子类与U子原因一致。独立视觉核验另有待完成状态。
zh.limitation: 归因以保存的证据、冻结门槛和身份规则为条件。第①类指进入跟踪器的框与参考框的兼容性；画面可观察性由人工核验，因果解释还需要额外证据。U 类保留在完整分母中。
zh.question: 沿同一个参考人物的事件，定位已保存证据在哪一阶段停止支持找回。

en.title: E2: controlled temporal deletion
en.purpose: Measure how the temporal arrangement of missing observations changes event recovery at matched retained-box counts.
en.mechanism: Replay dispersed and blocked deletion masks on GT-body inputs with the frozen O1 pipeline, fixed grid and seeds; summarize ALL/low response curves.
en.status: Approved historical recomputation: 48/48 mask manifests and bitwise reconstruction pass; 50 runs and 250 count cells agree. In the displayed 01/02 grid, contiguous missing blocks gave lower IVR than dispersed missing observations at matched retention. Thirteen missing frames create a 0.56 s observation gap, exceeding the frozen 0.5 s event-memory limit even when the tracker ID survives.
en.limitation: Thirteen deleted consecutive frames create a 0.56-second endpoint gap at 25 fps, interacting with the fixed 0.5-second decoder reset. Seed mean/min/max describe mask variation. The experiment's information condition is GT-box input.
en.question: Measure how the temporal arrangement of missing observations changes event recovery at matched retained-box counts.

zh.title: E2：受控时间删除
zh.purpose: 在保留框数量相同的条件下，测量缺失观测的时间排列如何影响事件找回。
zh.mechanism: 对GT身体框执行分散删除与连续块删除，使用冻结O1流程、固定网格和种子，汇总ALL/low响应曲线。
zh.status: 已有正式历史复算：48/48删除清单与逐位重建通过，50次运行的250个计数格一致。 在已报告的 01/02 网格中，保留量相同时，连续缺失的 IVR 低于分散缺失。连续缺 13 帧形成 0.56 s 的观测间隔，超过事件链 0.5 s 的记忆上限，即使跟踪 ID 仍保留也会重置。
zh.limitation: 25fps下连续删除13帧使保留端点间隔达到0.56秒，与固定0.5秒解码重置直接相互作用。种子的mean/min/max描述删除变化；实验信息条件为GT框输入。
zh.question: 在保留框数量相同的条件下，测量缺失观测的时间排列如何影响事件找回。

en.title: E3: ranges over equally optimal matchings
en.purpose: Show whether equivalent event assignments change visibility-stratum counts or event membership.
en.mechanism: Hold maximum match cardinality and minimum total time difference fixed, then find the minimum and maximum relevant counts among all equivalent optima. Stratify after global matching.
en.status: Implemented scoring safeguard. Packaged records retain zero-width identity ranges for the reported cases, including the three-panel regression.
en.limitation: The ranges quantify assignment ambiguity under fixed optimization objectives. Sampling uncertainty and generalization require separate statistical evidence.
en.question: Show whether equivalent event assignments change visibility-stratum counts or event membership.

zh.title: E3：同等最优匹配范围
zh.purpose: 展示等价事件配对是否改变可见度分档计数或事件成员资格。
zh.mechanism: 固定最大配对数与最小总时差，再在全部等价最优解中求相关计数的最小、最大值；先全局匹配，后分档。
zh.status: 已实现的评分防护。仓库保留所报案例身份范围宽度为零的记录，包括三面板回归。
zh.limitation: 范围度量固定优化目标下的分配歧义；抽样不确定性与泛化需要各自的统计证据。
zh.question: 展示等价事件配对是否改变可见度分档计数或事件成员资格。

en.title: E4: standard tracking-metric comparison
en.purpose: Compare event IVR with conventional frame-level tracking measurements and visibility-dependent degradation.
en.mechanism: Use TrackEval HOTA, IDF1 and MOTA, with separately defined low-visibility frame-level IDR. Preserve the coordinate-origin correction and its provenance.
en.status: Historical descriptive results are transcribed in RESULTS Table 2. The original eight corrected units have a 272-field recomputation record; expanded YOLOX rows carry their own evidence scope. Conventional frame-level measures also show degradation when stratified by visibility.
en.limitation: Event-window visibility and single-frame visibility define different populations. Each table row inherits only its stated recomputation coverage.
en.question: Compare event IVR with conventional frame-level tracking measurements and visibility-dependent degradation.

zh.title: E4：常规跟踪指标对照
zh.purpose: 比较事件IVR与常规逐框跟踪指标，并检查可见度相关退化。
zh.mechanism: 使用TrackEval的HOTA、IDF1、MOTA，另列明确口径的低可见度逐框IDR；保留坐标原点修正及来源。
zh.status: 历史描述性结果见RESULTS表2。原八个坐标修正单位有272字段复算记录，扩展YOLOX行各按自己的证据范围标注。 常规逐框指标按可见度分档后，同样能显示性能下降。
zh.limitation: 事件窗口可见度与单帧可见度对应不同观测总体；每行仅继承其明示复算范围。
zh.question: 比较事件IVR与常规逐框跟踪指标，并检查可见度相关退化。

en.title: E5: conditional targeted-method proposal
en.purpose: Reserve a possible new mechanism for repeated, identifiable errors that still contain usable recovery evidence.
en.mechanism: A proposal would follow E1 evidence, explain its difference from M4 and specify a separately reviewed inference or tracking intervention.
en.status: Conditional proposal in the #78 design. An E1 result identifying a dominant, repairable failure would be needed before proposing a targeted method for separate review.
en.limitation: The available source defines an entry condition and planning slot. A concrete E5 method and its empirical outcome remain unspecified.
en.question: Reserve a possible new mechanism for repeated, identifiable errors that still contain usable recovery evidence.

zh.title: E5：有条件的针对性方法提案
zh.purpose: 为重复、可识别且仍有可用恢复证据的错误预留新机制研究入口。
zh.mechanism: 提案应由E1证据支持，说明相对M4的机制差异，并给出单独审核的推理或跟踪干预设计。
zh.status: #78 中的条件性方案。只有 E1 指向占主导且可修补的失败，才据此提出针对性方法并单独审核。
zh.limitation: 现有来源定义了进入条件与规划位置；具体E5方法及实证结果尚未指定。
zh.question: 为重复、可识别且仍有可用恢复证据的错误预留新机制研究入口。

en.title: P1: YOLO11x-pose baseline pipeline
en.purpose: Provide the original detector/tracker/event baseline for method development.
en.mechanism: YOLO11x-pose with imgsz=2560, conf=0.25, IoU=0.7 and max_det=300, followed by the index-fixed ByteTrack implementation, box-bottom-centre points and frozen event logic.
en.status: Historical baseline. Whole-sequence E1-v2 development results include 27/180 low-bin matches; the older module-selection protocol uses its own 671-event core population.
en.limitation: P1's saved detections cover its post-processing threshold. Earlier and later scoring populations and identity conventions must retain their version labels.
en.question: Provide the original detector/tracker/event baseline for method development.

zh.title: P1：YOLO11x-pose基线流程
zh.purpose: 作为方法开发最初的检测、跟踪与事件基线。
zh.mechanism: YOLO11x-pose采用imgsz=2560、conf=0.25、IoU=0.7、max_det=300，接索引修复版ByteTrack、框底中点及冻结事件逻辑。
zh.status: 历史基线。全序列E1-v2开发表低档为27/180；旧模块选择协议使用自己的671条核心母体。
zh.limitation: P1保存的是其后处理门限内检测。早晚评分母体与身份口径应保留各自版本标记。
zh.question: 作为方法开发最初的检测、跟踪与事件基线。

en.title: P2: CrowdDet baseline pipeline
en.purpose: Provide the stronger CrowdDet detector baseline and the base for v11's M3/M4 additions.
en.mechanism: The E1 contract identifies CrowdDet post-processed detections saved above 0.01 and an actual tracker-input pool at score≥0.25; attribution follows emitted tracker_rows and global detection indices.
en.status: Historical baseline. Whole-sequence development low-bin recovery is 81/180. Confirmation low-bin counts are 43/136 on 03 and 39/291 on 05.
en.limitation: The saved detection pool and the admitted tracker pool have different thresholds. Detector replacement and downstream module effects need separate comparisons.
en.question: Provide the stronger CrowdDet detector baseline and the base for v11's M3/M4 additions.

zh.title: P2：CrowdDet基线流程
zh.purpose: 提供较强的CrowdDet检测基线，并作为v11加入M3/M4的基础。
zh.mechanism: E1合同规定保存score>0.01的CrowdDet后处理检测，实际入跟踪池为score≥0.25；归因沿实际tracker_rows与全局检测索引追踪。
zh.status: 历史基线。全序列开发低档为81/180；确认低档为03的43/136和05的39/291。
zh.limitation: 保存检测池与实际入跟踪池门限不同；检测器替换与下游模块效果需要分别比较。
zh.question: 提供较强的CrowdDet检测基线，并作为v11加入M3/M4的基础。

en.title: O1: GT-body input through tracking
en.purpose: Inspect the event pipeline under stronger body-box input information.
en.mechanism: Construct score-1 body boxes from GT and feed the frozen ByteTrack pipeline; E1 still uses geometric matching for admitted inputs and actual emitted tracker rows.
en.status: Historical diagnostic reference: development low-bin recovery is 173/180 and overall recovery is 711/724.
en.limitation: GT full-body boxes include occluded extent and share provenance with derived labels. Results describe this information condition; recoverability from image pixels remains a separate question.
en.question: Inspect the event pipeline under stronger body-box input information.

zh.title: O1：GT身体框输入跟踪流程
zh.purpose: 在更强的身体框输入信息下检查事件链。
zh.mechanism: 用GT构造分数为1的身体框，送入冻结ByteTrack；E1仍以几何匹配关联入池框，并检查实际输出轨迹行。
zh.status: 历史诊断参照：开发低档173/180，总体711/724。
zh.limitation: GT全身框包含遮挡范围，并与派生标签共享来源。结果描述这一信息条件；图像像素中的可恢复性另需证据。
zh.question: 在更强的身体框输入信息下检查事件链。

en.title: O2: GT-body and GT-identity oracle trajectories
en.purpose: Inspect the event chain with both reference body boxes and reference identities supplied.
en.mechanism: GT boxes and source_gt_id directly construct oracle observations/trajectories. E1 labels the pool oracle_supplied_observations; empty tracker_rows is expected by this construction.
en.status: Included in the approved E1 recomputation scope of five systems ×724 events. The packaged summary exposes selected systems' aggregates and identifies O2's inclusion in the receipt.
en.limitation: The construction supplies identity as privileged reference information. E1 classes ① and ② have a different applicability scope for this oracle.
en.question: Inspect the event chain with both reference body boxes and reference identities supplied.

zh.title: O2：GT身体框与GT身份oracle轨迹
zh.purpose: 在同时提供参考身体框和参考身份的条件下检查事件链。
zh.mechanism: GT框与source_gt_id直接组成oracle观测和轨迹。E1将池标为oracle_supplied_observations；按该构造tracker_rows预期为空。
zh.status: 包含于已正式复算的五系统×724事件范围。仓库摘要展示部分系统聚合值，并明确O2在回执范围内。
zh.limitation: 该构造把身份作为特权参考信息输入；E1的①、②在此oracle中具有专门的适用范围。
zh.question: 在同时提供参考身体框和参考身份的条件下检查事件链。

en.title: v11: selected P2+M3+M4 combination
en.purpose: Combine CrowdDet with low-score admission and local tracklet stitching for identity-crossing recovery.
en.mechanism: The selected original configuration is P2+M3+M4. Native event points use raw detection footpoints; M4 remaps identities while retaining actual post-M4 tracker_rows for identity scoring. YOLOX+v11 uses a different detector with this downstream pipeline.
en.status: Selected in historical development. Later confirmation supports YOLOX+v11 as a strong established-component baseline; CrowdDet v11 low counts versus P2 are 43 versus 43 on 03 and 36 versus 39 on 05.
en.limitation: Specify the detector whenever naming v11. Native footpoint events and standard-track bottom-centre events have distinct interfaces. The confirmation comparison supports the full pipeline under its fixed inputs.
en.question: Combine CrowdDet with low-score admission and local tracklet stitching for identity-crossing recovery.

zh.title: v11：选定的P2+M3+M4组合
zh.purpose: 将CrowdDet、低分准入与局部轨迹拼接组合，用于身份越线找回。
zh.mechanism: 原始选定配置为P2+M3+M4。原生事件使用原检测脚点，M4重映射身份，并保存实际post-M4 tracker_rows用于身份评分。YOLOX+v11更换检测器，沿用这套下游流程。
zh.status: 历史开发中选定。后续确认支持YOLOX+v11作为成熟组件强基线；CrowdDet v11对P2低档计数在03为43对43、05为36对39。
zh.limitation: 提到v11时应同时写明检测器。原生脚点事件与标准轨迹底中点事件有各自接口；确认比较支持固定输入下的整条流程。
zh.question: 将CrowdDet、低分准入与局部轨迹拼接组合，用于身份越线找回。

en.title: M1a: native-width inference
en.purpose: Test the detector input-resolution setting.
en.mechanism: Set imgsz to the native image width, 1920 for 01/02, with the remaining P1 pipeline fixed.
en.status: Historical development variant v01. The selection table records lower low-bin IVR than P1, while the high-bin and precision constraints pass.
en.limitation: This result belongs to the original 671-confirmed-event core-window selection protocol and its fixed detector configuration.
en.question: Test the detector input-resolution setting.

zh.title: M1a：原生宽度推理
zh.purpose: 检验检测输入分辨率设置。
zh.mechanism: imgsz设为原图宽度，01/02为1920，其余P1流程固定。
zh.status: 历史开发变体v01。选择表记录其低档IVR低于P1，高档与精确率约束通过。
zh.limitation: 结果属于原671条确认事件核心窗选择协议及其固定检测配置。
zh.question: 检验检测输入分辨率设置。

en.title: M1b: tiled inference
en.purpose: Test whether tile-scale detections improve crowded-scene recovery.
en.mechanism: Combine one full-image pass at imgsz=2560 with a 2×2 tiling at imgsz=1280 per tile and 15% overlap, then class-agnostic NMS at IoU=0.7 and max_det=1000.
en.status: Historical v02 and combination variants. The selection report records degraded identity association and failed safety constraints in all tested M1b combinations.
en.limitation: The finding covers this fixed tiling and merge configuration on the historical development population.
en.question: Test whether tile-scale detections improve crowded-scene recovery.

zh.title: M1b：切块推理
zh.purpose: 检验切块尺度检测是否改善拥挤场景找回。
zh.mechanism: 整图imgsz=2560推理一次，另做2×2切块，每块imgsz=1280、重叠15%；合并后执行IoU=0.7的类别无关NMS，max_det=1000。
zh.status: 历史v02及组合变体。选择报告记录所有已测M1b组合身份关联退化，安全约束未通过。
zh.limitation: 结论覆盖该固定切块、合并配置及历史开发母体。
zh.question: 检验切块尺度检测是否改善拥挤场景找回。

en.title: M2: relaxed NMS overlap threshold
en.purpose: Test whether retaining more overlapping detections improves recovery.
en.mechanism: Change P1 NMS IoU from 0.7 to 0.85 with the remaining pipeline fixed.
en.status: Historical development variant v03. The selection table records lower low-bin IVR than P1 and passing high-bin/precision constraints.
en.limitation: The result covers one preset threshold in the original development selection protocol.
en.question: Test whether retaining more overlapping detections improves recovery.

zh.title: M2：放宽NMS重叠门限
zh.purpose: 检验保留更多重叠检测是否改善找回。
zh.mechanism: 将P1的NMS IoU由0.7改为0.85，其余流程固定。
zh.status: 历史开发变体v03。选择表记录低档IVR低于P1，高档与精确率约束通过。
zh.limitation: 结果覆盖原开发选择协议中的这一个预设门限。
zh.question: 检验保留更多重叠检测是否改善找回。

en.title: M3: low-confidence detection pool
en.purpose: Give tracking access to lower-scoring detection evidence.
en.mechanism: Lower admission confidence to 0.10; boxes scoring 0.10–0.25 enter ByteTrack's low-score pool, with high=0.25, low=0.10 and new=0.25.
en.status: Tested alone and in combinations, then retained in the selected v11 configuration. The native v11 contract explicitly applies admission 0.10.
en.limitation: A larger admitted pool changes evidence availability. Its isolated contribution requires the relevant fixed comparison, with detector and post-processing identified.
en.question: Give tracking access to lower-scoring detection evidence.

zh.title: M3：低置信度检测池
zh.purpose: 让跟踪器获得较低分数的检测证据。
zh.mechanism: 准入conf降至0.10；0.10–0.25分框进入ByteTrack低分池，high=0.25、low=0.10、new=0.25。
zh.status: 曾单独及组合测试，后保留于选定v11。原生v11合同明确使用0.10准入门限。
zh.limitation: 扩大准入池会改变证据可用性；独立贡献需结合指定检测器和后处理的固定对照解释。
zh.question: 让跟踪器获得较低分数的检测证据。

en.title: M4: local tracklet stitching near a gate
en.purpose: Reconnect compatible track fragments before extracting region events.
en.mechanism: The design considers an ending track near a gate and a starting track within 1 second, extrapolates from the final 0.5-second velocity window, and accepts mutually unique best pairs within one G1 body height. Identity remapping uses the frozen complete policy and retains observed points.
en.status: Retained in v11. The later same-CrowdDet confirmation comparison gives low counts 43 versus 43 on 03 and 36 versus 39 on 05 for v11 versus P2.
en.limitation: The detailed implementation decisions and frozen policy refine the original design. The whole YOLOX+v11 comparison has multiple differing components; M4 attribution uses its own fixed intervention evidence.
en.question: Reconnect compatible track fragments before extracting region events.

zh.title: M4：口线附近的局部轨迹拼接
zh.purpose: 在提取区域事件前重连兼容轨迹片段。
zh.mechanism: 设计检查口线附近结束的轨迹与1秒内开始的轨迹，用末0.5秒速度窗作常速外推，在一个G1身高范围内接受互为唯一最佳配对。实际身份重映射依冻结完整策略，保留已观测点。
zh.status: 保留于v11。后续同CrowdDet确认比较中，v11对P2低档计数在03为43对43、05为36对39。
zh.limitation: 具体实现决定与冻结策略细化原设计。YOLOX+v11整体比较存在多个组件差异，M4归因依自身固定干预证据。
zh.question: 在提取区域事件前重连兼容轨迹片段。

en.title: IVR: identity-qualified crossing recovery
en.purpose: Measure recovery of reference crossing events for the correct annotated person.
en.mechanism: IVR = identity-correct matched events / rule-confirmed reference events. Matching requires the same person and direction, time difference≤1 second and distance≤the corresponding GT body height. Visibility bins use mean GT visibility within ±25 frames of reference target-region entry.
en.status: Frozen principal event metric. The whole-sequence 01/02 population contains 724 rule-confirmed events among 901 transitions.
en.limitation: Interpret results under the frozen reference and identity rules. Repeated people and gates create dependent events; human label support has its own QC status.
en.question: Measure recovery of reference crossing events for the correct annotated person.

zh.title: IVR：身份越线找回率
zh.purpose: 测量参考越线事件是否由正确的标注人物身份找回。
zh.mechanism: IVR=身份正确匹配事件数/规则确认参考事件数。匹配要求同人、同方向、时差≤1秒、距离≤对应GT身高。可见度分档使用参考目标区首次进入帧前后各25帧的GT平均可见度。
zh.status: 冻结的主要事件指标。01/02全序列901次转换中有724次规则确认事件。
zh.limitation: 按冻结参考与身份规则解释。同一人物和多口线产生相关事件，标签视觉支持另有人工QC状态。
zh.question: 测量参考越线事件是否由正确的标注人物身份找回。

en.title: Identity precision
en.purpose: Measure the fraction of reported final events that correctly match a reference event.
en.mechanism: Identity precision = identity-correct matched events / all final system events. The denominator includes unknown, mixed and ignored identity states.
en.status: Frozen scoring metric reported with IVR in development and confirmation tables.
en.limitation: Use the final-event denominator for the relevant scoring version. Stadium rule-pairing precision follows a separate window and pairing convention.
en.question: Measure the fraction of reported final events that correctly match a reference event.

zh.title: 身份精确率
zh.purpose: 衡量系统最终报出的事件中，正确匹配参考事件的比例。
zh.mechanism: 身份精确率=身份正确匹配事件数/全部最终系统事件数；分母包含unknown、mixed与ignore身份状态。
zh.status: 冻结评分指标，与IVR共同列于开发和确认表。
zh.limitation: 使用对应评分版本的最终事件分母。体育场规则配对精确率采用单独的窗口和配对约定。
zh.question: 衡量系统最终报出的事件中，正确匹配参考事件的比例。

en.title: ReID #93: fixed appearance-association baseline
en.purpose: Test an appearance-based association configuration in the YOLOX+BoT-SORT pipeline.
en.mechanism: Compare the fixed ReID configuration with the saved no-ReID BoT-SORT baseline on 01/02 under the same event-scoring framework.
en.status: BASELINE_ONLY. Low-bin recovery is 81/180 versus 84/180, a net change of −3; high-bin recovery is 208/210. Safety criteria pass, while the practical low-bin improvement gate remains unmet.
en.limitation: The result covers the specified configuration. The confirmation membership is fixed separately and excludes this #93 baseline; broader appearance-association behavior remains outside this comparison.
en.question: Test an appearance-based association configuration in the YOLOX+BoT-SORT pipeline.

zh.title: ReID #93：固定外观关联基线
zh.purpose: 检验YOLOX+BoT-SORT流程中的一套外观关联配置。
zh.mechanism: 在01/02及相同事件评分框架下，将固定ReID配置与已保存的无ReID BoT-SORT基线比较。
zh.status: BASELINE_ONLY。低档81/180对84/180，净变−3；高档208/210。安全条件通过，实用低档增益关口未达到。
zh.limitation: 结果覆盖指定配置。确认成员单独冻结，其中排除#93基线；更广泛的外观关联行为另需比较。
zh.question: 检验YOLOX+BoT-SORT流程中的一套外观关联配置。

en.title: GT and oracle information conditions
en.purpose: Make the reference information available to each diagnostic pipeline explicit.
en.mechanism: GT supplies annotated boxes, identities and visibility for label derivation and evaluation. O1 supplies GT-body boxes to tracking; O2 supplies GT-body boxes and identities directly as oracle trajectories.
en.status: Established reference conditions used in the historical comparisons and E1 diagnostics. Rule-derived labels retain their recorded human-QC status.
en.limitation: Full-body GT can include amodal or occluded extent. Shared source boxes connect the oracle inputs and derived labels; image-level visual support requires independent human evidence.
en.question: Make the reference information available to each diagnostic pipeline explicit.

zh.title: GT与oracle信息条件
zh.purpose: 明确各诊断流程使用了哪些参考信息。
zh.mechanism: GT提供标注框、身份与可见度，用于标签派生和评价。O1把GT身体框送入跟踪，O2直接使用GT身体框与身份组成oracle轨迹。
zh.status: 历史比较与E1诊断中采用的既定参照条件。规则派生标签保留其已记录人工QC状态。
zh.limitation: 全身GT可包含amodal或遮挡范围。Oracle输入与派生标签共享来源框，图像中的视觉支持依赖独立人工证据。
zh.question: 明确各诊断流程使用了哪些参考信息。
